description: Giovanni—Geospatial Interactive Online Visualization and Analysis Infrastructure is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NASA Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center. This web-based application provides way to visualize, analyze, and access vast amounts of earth science remote sensing data without having to download the data. Giovanni is an acronym for G eospatial I nteractive O nline V isualization AN d A nalysis I nfrastructure. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Drought, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
